excerpt: From Intern to Employee: Designing Internship Programs That Lead to Full-Time Employment Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Employee burnout is a growing concern for organizations worldwide, leading to decreased productivity, higher absenteeism, and increased turnover. Preventing burnout is not only vital for employee well-being but also for improving employee retention—a top priority for businesses seeking sustainable growth. This comprehensive guide explores the causes of burnout, its impact on retention, and actionable strategies to create a healthier, more resilient workplace. What Is Employee Burnout?
